requirements.evidence: Five focused suites (49 tests) cover local product/SKU and physical-attribute behavior. Remote aggregate checks found five draft products, four draft SKUs and no duplicate keys or broken media links; authenticated remote operations and commercial/lifecycle completeness remain unverified.

Remote schema inspection found no physical_attributes column on erp_catalog_items or erp_catalog_variants; migration 20261102093000 is absent from remote history. Local migration lint/pgTAP is blocked by unavailable Docker.
Generated numeric keys/SKUs and legacy CRM compatibility are covered by source/tests; authenticated remote behavior and local migration lint are unverified.

Remote archive function rejects categories with active product/SKU assignments. Local migration 019 also blocks, but pgTAP 019 expects assignments to be preserved; the migration is absent remotely and tests are unrun.

Shared Files-backed library reuse, upload, tags, preview renewal, reorder and detach have local tests. Authenticated remote tenant/processing behavior and mobile-web operation parity remain unverified.

Remote cost mutation policies and RPC require catalog.cost.manage without also requiring catalog.cost.read; migration 20261027160000 is absent remotely. Local tests/pgTAP cover the intended contract, but no authenticated remote operation was tested.

Remote RLS and audit triggers are present, but the effective write function returns true for one organization whose security_gates_ready is false; global control/readiness are true. No control was changed and no remote mutation was performed.

User confirmed desktop web plus responsive mobile web; native apps are deferred. The direct route previously redirected to login at 560x925. Structural route smoke covers list/edit/legacy paths on both responsive web surfaces; authenticated desktop/mobile-web operations remain unverified.
The implementation plan and ledger are approved with task-scoped approvals. Build and verification remain blocked; the route audit is the upstream blocker and dependent tasks remain incomplete.

detected_failure.summary: Supabase Dev does not match the current Products security/domain contract: cost mutation omits the read permission, one organization's effective write gate is true despite readiness=false, category archive behavior conflicts with the expected assignment-preserving contract, and physical-attribute columns are absent.

next_handoff: An authenticated Platform owner must disable the affected organization's write control through set_erp_product_write_control; resolve the category migration/test/domain contract mismatch; restore Docker and run local migration lint plus pgTAP 017/019/020; deploy validated migrations only after separate authorization; then verify authenticated desktop and responsive mobile-web operations.
